summary: Live-service game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: World of Warships
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC build with region/account/build state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with live servers

primary.why: World of Warships is a live naval-combat game whose ship roster, economy, events, and balance change over time. PC is the main route and best capture/settings target, while Legends and mobile are separate platform variants.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC client through Wargaming Game Center or Steam. Record region/server, build/date, account state, ships/tiers, premium time/economy, events, mods, graphics settings, battle mode, and whether Legends/mobile were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting those separate platform variants.
secondary.why: They are not the same service/build as the PC game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record region, build, account, premium/economy state, events, mods, and battle mode.
